name: Fast Moth 57
author: themrsami
description: Rounded white submit button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes and text colour changes. On focus, text colour changes and background changes.
html:
<button
  class="inline-block py-2 px-6 rounded-l-xl rounded-t-xl bg-[#7747FF] hover:bg-white hover:text-[#7747FF] focus:text-[#7747FF] focus:bg-gray-200 text-gray-50 font-bold leading-loose transition duration-200"
>
  Submit
</button>
